text:
Here is the test suite in Gherkin (BDD DSL) notation:

```gherkin
Feature: Prescription and Payment System

  Scenario: System is self-contained and no data is shared with third parties
    Given the system is running with Django 2.0 and MySQL
    When a chemist logs in to the system
    Then the system does not share any data with third parties
    And the chemist can access the prescriptions

  Scenario: Only emails are sent to patients
    Given a patient is registered in the system
    When a prescription is generated for the patient
    Then an email is sent to the patient with the full prescription and invoice

  Scenario: Interface with standard Payment Gateway is available
    Given the system is integrated with the standard Payment Gateway
    When a patient selects the payment option
    Then the payment interface is displayed

  Scenario: Secure payment options are available
    Given a patient has selected a payment option
    When the patient clicks the "Pay" button
    Then the payment is processed securely using Debit/Credit Cards and Net banking

  Scenario Outline: System supports various browsers and operating systems
    Given the system is running on <browser> and <operating_system>
    When a patient accesses the system
    Then the system is displayed correctly in <browser> on <operating_system>

    Examples:
      | browser      | operating_system |
      | Google Chrome | Windows 10       |
      | Mozilla Firefox | macOS            |
      | Safari        | iOS              |

  Scenario Outline: System handles invalid inputs
    Given the system is running with Django 2.0 and MySQL
    When a chemist logs in with invalid credentials
    Then the system displays an error message

    Examples:
      | username | password |
      | invalid  | invalid  |
```
